title: Compile error when checking `bevy_ui`

labels.name: A-UI
labels.description: Graphical user interfaces, styles, layouts, and widgets

body:
## Bevy version

main (`9153bd0e`)

## \[Optional\] Relevant system information

- cargo 1.67.1 (8ecd4f20a 2023-01-10)
- Linux (Pop!_OS)

## What you did

Run `cargo check -p bevy_ui`

## What went wrong

I got compile errors:

```
error: could not compile `bevy_ui` due to 4 previous errors
```

## Additional information

I ran into this issue while porting [leafwing-input-manager](https://github.com/Leafwing-Studios/leafwing-input-manager/pull/317) to 0.10.

When I run `cargo check` on `bevy` I don't get any errors, same thing when I use the feature flags that we use on leafwing-input-manager.
